testimonialContent: “From the outset Josh was forthcoming with relevant and informative information, critical in being able to assess the market and in setting my expectations. The process was seamless - I was kept well informed throughout. The campaign was well directed and the advice sought was well received without me feeling pressured to move in any direction at any time. Josh and his team were a pleasure to deal with - professional and trusted at all times.”

“This is the third time we have used Josh to sell a property. His knowledge of the market has been spot on. He is a tireless worker who spoke to those prospective buyers who expressed a genuine interest on multiple occasions to determine what they needed to make the sale but always cognisant of what our requirements were. In addition he was unfailingly a wonderful person to deal with, we always had the feeling we were partners in the sale and not just another client.”

“Working with Josh Allen and his team on the sale of my property was an absolute delight. Not only did Josh achieve a record-breaking sale price for my apartment, but he also offered expert advice and guidance throughout the process, instilling a sense of comfort and complete trust in his ability to secure the best possible outcome.”
